evidence: This Synergy kit provides an all-in-one solution for medium-sized presentation applications. Suited for corporate or education markets that require a comprehensive solution for AV distribution and control. This kit includes a 4-input HDBaseT switcher, a feature-packed HDBaseT receiver and a 2.8” touchscreen controller. Use this kit to create a robust solution for medium conference spaces, corporate boardrooms, training centers and many other presentation-based applications.

Every major connection type is supported, including HDMI, USB-C, VGA and DisplayPort ensuring compatibility with all laptops, room PCs, document cameras or media players. AV signals can be sent up to 100m over HDBaseT, ideal for integrating into existing cable infrastructure.

Delivering visually lossless 4K UHD content with HDR and HDCP 2.2 support ensures compatibility with the latest UHD video sources, while a built-in scaler ensures hassle-free mixing of the latest 4K displays and 1080p screens within an installation.

Supporting traditional video walls, as well as customizable mosaic styles, perfect for building captivating & creative digital signage. JPEG2000 encoding ensuring distribution integrity and video latency of less than a single frame makes the 400 Series ideal for live environments.

Boasting the ultimate in signal flexibility, the 400 Series can discretely deliver audio, infrared and USB streams separate to the video via a modular IP network. True signal breakaway can create custom assignments, desirable in both commercial and residential applications.
Supports source content up to 4K/60 4:2:0 or 4K/30 RBG 8bit with HDCP 2.2
Includes 2 local HDMI inputs for switching to media players or signage when system is not in use.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

This Synergy kit provides an all-in-one solution for medium-sized presentation applications. Suited for corporate or education markets that require a comprehensive solution for AV distribution and control. This kit includes a 4-input HDBaseT switcher, a feature-packed HDBaseT receiver and a 2.8” touchscreen controller. Use this kit to create a robust solution for medium conference spaces, corporate boardrooms, training centers and many other presentation-based applications.

Every major connection type is supported, including HDMI, USB-C, VGA and DisplayPort ensuring compatibility with all laptops, room PCs, document cameras or media players. AV signals can be sent up to 100m over HDBaseT, ideal for integrating into existing cable infrastructure.

Delivering visually lossless 4K UHD content with HDR and HDCP 2.2 support ensures compatibility with the latest UHD video sources, while a built-in scaler ensures hassle-free mixing of the latest 4K displays and 1080p screens within an installation.

The 2.8” touchscreen provides a simple yet effective user interface for switching inputs on the transmitter and the ability to send CEC commands to turn on or off a remote display. The interface has been pre-built by WyreStorm and doesn’t require any programming

Supporting traditional video walls, as well as customizable mosaic styles, perfect for building captivating & creative digital signage. JPEG2000 encoding ensuring distribution integrity and video latency of less than a single frame makes the 400 Series ideal for live environments.

The transmitter and receiver support USB extension capabilities. This allows laptops to utilize connected peripheral devices such as a remote webcam & speakerphone for online meetings or a touchscreen/smart display for interactive learning experiences.

Boasting the ultimate in signal flexibility, the 400 Series can discretely deliver audio, infrared and USB streams separate to the video via a modular IP network. True signal breakaway can create custom assignments, desirable in both commercial and residential applications.
Pre-configured UI’s designed for simple end-user experience
RJ45 connection and RS-422 communication to included RS-232 converter
Supports source content up to 4K/60 4:2:0 or 4K/30 RBG 8bit with HDCP 2.2
USB-C input supports Alt-mode functionality for AV and USB device connection through a single cable
Supports source content up to 4K/60 4:2:0 or 4K30 RGB 8bit up to 100m/328ft
Includes 2 local HDMI inputs for switching to media players or signage when system is not in use.
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx
